attributes.name: @model "ollama:..."
attributes.notes: Read by `ai.*` to pick the Ollama model

attributes.name: @role "..."
attributes.notes: Prepended as `"You are {role}.\n\n..."` to every `ai.*` system prompt

attributes.name: @on_start { ... }
attributes.notes: Block runs once when the agent starts

attributes.name: @on_stop { ... }
attributes.notes: Block runs once when the agent stops (v0.1.4)

attributes.name: @tools [...]
attributes.notes: Deny-by-default capability gating for effectful modules (ai, io, http, email, file, shell, db, search, env); pure-compute modules are never gated; `@tools all` is the explicit unrestricted form; uncovered direct calls are compile errors, transitive calls raise `CapabilityError` at runtime; `if` guards re-evaluated per turn

attributes.name: @memory persistent\|session\|none
attributes.notes: Selects memory scope; enforced at runtime (v0.1.10)

attributes.name: @rules [...]
attributes.notes: Injected as a bullet list into the system prompt of every `ai.*` call (v0.1.3)

attributes.name: @limits { ... }
attributes.notes: `timeout` enforced via `control.with_timeout` (v0.1.7); `max_tokens` now threaded into the provider request as the generation cap; `max_cost` extracted but not enforced

attributes.name: @provider <name>
attributes.notes: Selects a built-in backend (`ollama`/`openai`/`anthropic`) or a user-authored provider type for the agent; unknown built-in name is a compile error. Per-call override via `provider:` model-tag prefix; program default via `KEEL_PROVIDER`. User-authored providers via `impl LlmProvider` + `ai.install`/`@provider` (v0.2.4)

namespaces.name: std/ai
namespaces.implemented_ops: `classify`, `summarize` (format/max), `draft`, `extract` (as: T), `translate`, `decide`, `prompt` (response_format: json); swappable built-in backends — Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude) — via `@model "provider:model"`, `@provider`, or `KEEL_PROVIDER`; user-authored providers via `impl LlmProvider` + `ai.install`/`@provider` (SPEC §5.5)

namespaces.name: std/log
namespaces.purpose: Structured logging: `info`, `warn`, `error`, `debug`, plus `set_level`, `level`. Threshold default is `info`; raise via `--log-level debug`, `KEEL_LOG_LEVEL=debug`, or `log.set_level("debug")` at runtime.

namespaces.name: std/memory
namespaces.purpose: Per-agent key-value store: `remember`, `recall`, `forget`. Scope set by `@memory session\|persistent\|none` (default: session). Persistent mode writes `~/.keel/memory/<stem>_<hash12>/<agent>.json`.

namespaces.name: std/cache
namespaces.gaps: `cache.get` return type undocumented — at runtime returns the stored value at its original type, or `none` if absent or expired; the Keel-visible type is `dynamic?` (dynamic because the checker cannot know what was stored, nullable for absent keys). Add `cache.get(key) -> dynamic?` to SPEC §3 so users know the stored type is preserved and a narrow cast (`as T`) recovers it.

namespaces.name: String value methods
namespaces.implemented_ops: `.matches`, `.extract`, `.truncate`, `.pad`, `.find_all`, `.sub` — all string ops on the value; `Str` namespace removed
namespaces.purpose: Regex and formatting directly on string values: matches, extract, find_all, sub, truncate, pad

namespaces.name: std/json
namespaces.gaps: `json.parse` return-type semantics undocumented — at runtime, JSON objects become `Value::Map` (field access `parsed.key` works), arrays become `Value::List` (index `parsed[i]` works), numbers become `int` or `float`, strings become `str`. None of this is stated in SPEC or ROADMAP. Add to SPEC §3 and to `docs/src/guide/` so users know `(json.parse(body) as dynamic).field` is valid Keel.

namespaces.name: std/search
namespaces.gaps: Registered; all methods raise a clear "planned for v0.2" error
namespaces.purpose: Web search providers: `web(query)` — registered; raises "planned for v0.2" error

namespaces.name: std/time
namespaces.purpose: Factories: `now()`, `now(tz: name)`, `parse(str)`, `parse(str, tz: name)`, `epoch_ms()` → `int`. Methods on value: `dt.parts()` → map, `dt.format(as: pattern)` → `str?`. Duration literals: `500.ms` … `1.week`. Operators: `dt ± dur → dt`, `dt - dt → duration`, `<`/`>` comparison. Naive strings rejected — use RFC 3339 or `tz:`.

namespaces.name: std/random
namespaces.purpose: Pseudo-random generation: `float()`, `int(min:, max:)`, `bool()`. Use `Crypto` for security-sensitive randomness.

namespaces.name: std/uuid
namespaces.purpose: UUID values: `v4`, `v7`, deterministic `v5`, `parse`, `uuid()` alias, and value methods `version`, `format`, `to_str`.

namespaces.name: std/crypto
namespaces.purpose: Cryptographic primitives: fixed safe SHA-2 hash/HMAC methods, `token`, `random_bytes`.

namespaces.name: std/math
namespaces.gaps: All return `float`; accept `int` or `float` input; domain errors raise
namespaces.purpose: Transcendentals: `sqrt`, `pow`, `exp`, `log` (natural), `log2`, `log10`, `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `atan2`. Constants: `PI()`, `E()`. All return `float`. Domain errors raise.

namespaces.name: std/shell
namespaces.implemented_ops: `run(cmd, stdin:?, cwd:?)` → `{ stdout: str, stderr: str, exit_code: int }`
namespaces.purpose: Subprocess bridge: execute shell commands via `/bin/sh -c` and capture stdout/stderr. Requires `@tools [shell]`.

cli.name: keel check
cli.notes: Type-check only, no execution; `--strict` rejects unknown-typed bindings

cli.name: keel fmt
cli.notes: Auto-format; idempotent round-trip against the AST

cli.name: keel test
cli.notes: Run top-level `test "name" { ... }` blocks; `--filter`, `--list`, `--fail-fast`, `--quiet`, `--debug`; directory paths recursively discover `.keel` files with tests

cli.name: keel repl
cli.notes: Interactive REPL; multi-line input, persistent environment

cli.name: keel lsp
cli.notes: Language server; diagnostics, hover, completion, go-to-definition, rename

cli.name: keel build
cli.notes: Native/LLVM AOT backend (designs/llvm-compilation.md); `--emit=kir` previews the scalar-subset mid-level IR, no codegen yet

cli.name: keel dap
cli.notes: Interpreter-backed Debug Adapter Protocol server (stdio); breakpoints (settable before or after configurationDone), step over/in/out, stack, locals, live agent state, expression evaluation; Async.spawn'd code undebugged, only innermost frame's variables inspectable, lines/columns always reported 1-indexed, no bundled editor integration yet (D0)
